effects.display_name: Bloodthirsty Tendril native arrow and unconditional hit control
effects.actual_behavior: Native BloodthirstyTendril extends AbstractArrow; three constructors delegate to parent and initialize its own knockback field0. Parent arrow collision/damage/source/PvP/fire/critical/hurt-return lifecycle remains the locked native contract. onHitEntity FIRST invokes parent then unconditionally invokes TendrilHits with collided entity and CURRENT projectile getOwner; no parent hurt-success check is introduced. Helper requires both nonnull and owner!=victim, but no allied/team/owned-pet predicate. It writes absolute VICTIM velocity (-2*sin(radians(ownerYaw+180)),(sin(radians(-ownerPitch))+.5)*1.5,-2*cos(radians(ownerYaw))) regardless of blocking/damage success/KnockbackResistance. Blocking Living victim scans its modifiable ItemHandler capability copies for BaneOfDarkness; if no Bane found, server command from impact position,source entity null, gives ALL type ScorpioidBloodluster within20 Regeneration2 SECONDS/amplifier4. It does not specifically heal owner and does not require successful damage. Nonblocking victim with native Wither requests80/1,false,false,otherwise60/0,false,false; blocking skips both. Native parent doPostHurtEffects invoked then subtracts victim arrow count1 without an extra clamp; no additional damage is introduced there. Ordinary doKnockback uses field>0: normalized horizontal projectile motion * field*.6*max(0,1-targetKnockbackResistance), then additive pushY.1 only if nonzero horizontal result. Retaliation anonymous overrides instead use captured knockback2/piercing2; same resistance/formula, followed by the separate unconditional absolute hit movement. tick FIRST calls parent, then particle-only flying helper, then discards if inGround WITHOUT an extra server/age/owner check. Global projectile-join cleanup is reused. Unreviewed static shoot-helper producers/other actor deliveries remain queued; the common native payload is closed here.
